About.description: A shared workspace to organize projects and customers, manage access, and work with your data.
About.signIn: Sign in or create an account
About.controlsDescription: Permissions are checked for each operation. Owners can manage members, review billing, and prepare exports or deletion requests.
About.configurationNotice: Integrations and optional services depend on each installation’s configuration.

Help.title: Help center
Help.dataDescription: In a project, upload UTF-8 text or CSV up to 1 MiB. Finish verification before using it. In Data, map columns, run validation, and review row errors. Jobs support up to 1,000 rows; you can cancel or retry with current access.
Help.exportsDescription: Exports expire after 24 hours. If your permissions or source data change, generate a new export.
Help.privacyDescription: In Privacy you can change optional notifications and analytics. Before deleting your account, transfer organizations where you are the sole owner. A prepared request can be canceled; confirmed deletion revokes access and cannot be undone.
Help.integrationsDescription: Owners and administrators can configure approved HTTPS destinations. Verify webhooks before use and save secrets when created or rotated. Audit access requires an additional permission granted by an owner.
Help.accessDescription: Confirm your identity for sensitive changes. If an organization needs owner recovery, contact your installation administrator. Recovery requires independent verification; do not share passwords or recovery codes.
